Dialogue_Text: "Avernus. A place burning with both fire and fear. While walking through it, poor mortals hoped to find a way out, find some sort of... place, or device, or spell to take them back to where they came from—to Westgate. Who would have thought that a simple deal with a devil would send them to such a place? All they wanted was some knowledge; some lore that would let them deal with the uncompromising future that awaited them. It was then, that very moment, when their hope was to be tested. A huge glabrezu appeared before them. Powerful. Ready to strike!"
Devils! Minsc and Boo are always ready to kick your butts! So, <CHARNAME>? Are we ready to show them who's the strongest group of heroes around?
"The devil summoned his helpers. It was not just him, but also the devilish bow-women, smiling at the adventurers with their sharp teeth!"
Would you like to fight against the devilish enemies from Avernus? Pay 3,500 gold pieces and you may use that book to do so.
I like the idea. Here's your gold.
No. I'll pass. At least for now.
I hope you know what you're doing!
